_source: SIA 265/1:2018, Tableau 6 (6.1.2.1) -- transcribed by hand from the French edition, SIA265-1-2018-FR.pdf p. 26, read off a render of the page (issue #110). The only copy of these values in the project.
_note: γ_M of the wood-based panels and of their connections, what a design value f_d = η_mod · f_k / γ_M is divided by (6.1.2.1). Plaques de plâtre fibrées: «à déterminer selon le produit», footnote 2 allowing about 1.3 -- left null here, never guessed. Footnote 1: γ_M = 1.0 in an accidental design situation, earthquakes excepted.
